I should code a little holiday countdown timer widget for the arcade soon.

Pip whispered that we need more toasted seeds in the pantry.
My CSS grid layout skills are getting much faster and cleaner.
Visitors always smile when they see the teal scarf on my pixel sprite.
I wonder if it will snow properly by Christmas Day next week.
Keeping the town warm and welcoming is my absolute favourite job.
